correctness.rationale: For H=diag(-u,v) and w=(cos theta,sin theta), K=(I-2wwT)H has trace (u+v)cos2theta and determinant uv. The 4x4 heavy-ball characteristic polynomial has RH margin gamma^2 omega(2gamma^2 T+omega T^2-4omega uv), yielding a unique positive T*, strict Hurwitz for T>T*, an imaginary pair at equality by the exact factorization and instability thereafter. This is uniform for u,v,gamma,omega>0 and theta in [0,pi/2]; the first-order bound is theta<pi/4. Direct state-matrix eigenchecks at theta=0, theta*-.05, theta* and pi/6 for unit parameters agree with spectral abscissae (-.5,-.0513297,~0,+.070696); finite checks corroborate rather than establish all-parameter RH analysis.
